column1: # Tomato32 unique ops catalog — grow toward 512; not padded.
# seq_cycles = value programmed into microcode cycles[1:0] (see main.v program_counter):
# That 2-bit sequencer is the only instruction-length control in main.v.
# mul_div is a separate priority-encoder+shift unit (mul-nxt_enc feedback); it is NOT
# "16 sequencer cycles". Multi-step mul/div completion is outside that 2-bit counter.
